content: Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00300, SRS_Rte_00167 The name of the Application Types Header File shall be formed by prefixing the component type symbol (see [SWS_Rte_06714], [SWS_Rte_06715]) with Rte_[Byps_] and appending the result with _Type.h . [Byps_] is an optionnal infix used when component wrapper method for bypass support is enabled for the related software component type.
